Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Dancing Mad Helper
Punchline: Real/fake callouts for Dancing Mad (Ultimate) phase 4.
Description: Reads Neo Exdeath's hidden real/fake flag and tells you whether your Compressed Water / Forked Lightning is a stack or spread, and whether your Acceleration Bomb needs stillness or motion.

Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Materia Sweep
Punchline: Extracts and retrieves materia across your inventory and armoury chest in one click.
Description: Goes through your inventory and armoury chest one item at a time, extracting materia from fully spiritbonded gear and optionally retrieving melded materia. Can skip anything registered to a gear set. Open with /materiasweep.

Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Max Melee Ring
Punchline: Draws each enemy's maximum melee range on the ground.
Description: Draws a red ring around enemies at the furthest distance your melee actions can reach, so you can hold max melee while dodging. Keep your character's centre inside the ring.

Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Stray Apocalypse Paths
Punchline: Draws the whole path of Kefka's Stray Apocalypse explosions as soon as each line starts casting.
Description: In Dancing Mad (Ultimate), each Stray Apocalypse starter fires six more explosions in a straight diagonal line, one every half second. The game only marks the starter. This plugin draws all six follow-up circles on the ground the moment the starter begins casting, and removes each one once it has gone off.
